src/core2.js.name: 2x2 cube brain
src/core2.js.description: Works out the whole 2x2 from four copied sides, checks it is a real cube, points at a wrong square, and finds the shortest solution.

src/core3.js.name: 3x3 cube brain
src/core3.js.description: Checks a copied 3x3 is a real cube, repairs a side copied the wrong way round, points at a wrong square, and prepares the cube for the solver.

src/flat.js.name: Flat turn table
src/flat.js.description: Says which side a turn is shown on (the front, or the top for a back-layer turn), which row or column slides and which way, and lists a side's stickers as the child sees them.
